let pfTab='overview',ffStatus='todo',ffProject='all';const statusOf=t=>String(t.status||'todo').toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,'');const projectForTask=(t,projects,activeId)=>t.projectId!=null?t.projectId:(activeId||projects[0]?.id);const taskList=items=>{if(!items.length)return '
No tasks here.
';return items.map(t=>'
').join('');};const fillTaskRows=(host,items)=>{host.innerHTML=taskList(items);[...host.querySelectorAll('.task-row')].forEach((row,i)=>{row.children[0].textContent=items[i].title;row.children[1].textContent=items[i].status;});};const render=()=>{const projects=api.getState('projects')||[],tasks=api.getState('tasks')||[],notes=api.getState('notes')||'',activeId=api.getState('activeProjectId')||projects[0]?.id;const pHost=root.querySelector('[data-pf-projects]');pHost.innerHTML='';projects.forEach(p=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.textContent=p.name||p.title;b.className=String(p.id)===String(activeId)?'active':'';b.onclick=()=>api.setState('activeProjectId',p.id);pHost.appendChild(b);});root.querySelectorAll('[data-pf-tabs] button').forEach(b=>{b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.tab===pfTab);b.onclick=()=>{pfTab=b.dataset.tab;render();};});const active=projects.find(p=>String(p.id)===String(activeId))||projects[0];const activeTasks=tasks.filter(t=>String(projectForTask(t,projects,activeId))===String(active?.id));const pf=root.querySelector('[data-pf-body]');if(pfTab==='overview'){pf.innerHTML='
'+activeTasks.length+'Tasks in '+(active?.name||active?.title||'project')+'
'+activeTasks.filter(t=>statusOf(t)!=='done').length+'Open
';}else if(pfTab==='tasks'){fillTaskRows(pf,activeTasks);}else{pf.innerHTML='
';pf.firstChild.textContent=typeof notes==='string'?(notes||'No notes yet.'):(notes[active?.id]||'No notes yet.');}const sel=root.querySelector('[data-ff-project]');const previous=ffProject;sel.innerHTML='';projects.forEach(p=>{const o=document.createElement('option');o.value=p.id;o.textContent=p.name||p.title;sel.appendChild(o);});sel.value=[...sel.options].some(o=>o.value===String(previous))?previous:'all';ffProject=sel.value;sel.onchange=()=>{ffProject=sel.value;render();};root.querySelectorAll('[data-ff-tabs] button').forEach(b=>{b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.status===ffStatus);b.onclick=()=>{ffStatus=b.dataset.status;render();};});let flowTasks=tasks.filter(t=>statusOf(t)===ffStatus);if(ffProject!=='all')flowTasks=flowTasks.filter(t=>String(projectForTask(t,projects,activeId))===String(ffProject));fillTaskRows(root.querySelector('[data-ff-body]'),flowTasks);};render();const unsubscribe=api.subscribe(render);
